$comment: OAuth 2.0 identity providers. Each provider is disabled until an admin fills in `clientId` (obtained from the provider's developer console). The redirect_uri to register is the site root: https://<user>.github.io/<repo>/ (no trailing hash). Full one-time setup steps → docs/AUTH_SETUP.md.

unsupported.label: Yahoo
unsupported.reason: Yahoo's token endpoint requires client_secret in the exchange call. Pure-browser PKCE cannot use it without a server-side proxy (Cloudflare Worker / Vercel Function). See docs/AUTH_SETUP.md §3.

unsupported.label: Rediff
unsupported.reason: Rediff Mail does not expose a public OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect endpoint. Use email OTP (deferred) or another provider.
